scope: #023 direct logical memory; no B2 or B7 credit from this experiment
overlap: one distance in folded loop periods (two syndrome rounds per period), shortened at the physical end
sampler: Stim samples independent mechanisms in each segment of one folded DEM, preserving decomposed fault correlations; no block initialization or measurement
decoder: independent MWPM on the nominal graph; past edges removed; future edges truncated to a virtual boundary; commit by earliest incident detector, carrying residual endpoints and the logical frame

stress.rule: Add one independent two-consecutive-ancilla-readout flip event per bulk stabilizer per folded period; the shared syndrome cancels, producing a temporal length-two edge
stress.classification: synthetic correlated readout stress, not a hardware calibration or worst-case claim

controls: same fault flags replayed through unpartitioned Stim DEM for all four (d,basis) cells with and without stress
bitwise equality of committed detector correction parity to the syndrome input
disable either cross-cut transfer and require the trajectory stitch check to reject the result
direct timeline and detector coordinates checked against the original circuit

qualification.interval: two-sided Wilson 95 percent upper bound, z=1.959963984540054
qualification.pair_gate: Both bases of the same distance must clear both horizons and both arms separately with a completed fixed cohort.
qualification.futility: Stop a row only when cumulative failures are greater than the static maximum for the full 1024-shot Wilson gate; no positive inference from a truncated row.
qualification.timing: Host sampled and decode/stitch windows timed separately; batch-window p99 is not single-trajectory latency and no hardware real-time claim is made.
